faq.heading: Questions before kick-off.
faq.intro: Short answers about joining, club approval and how FootyNet works.
faq.q1: Who can join as a player?
faq.a1: Any amateur or semi-professional player looking for a club. You create an account, confirm your email and complete your profile.
faq.a2: A club registers, then a FootyNet admin reviews the account. Until it is approved, the club sees a pending screen and cannot post job ads.
faq.a3: Registration does not ask for any payment details. You sign up with your email, a password and your profile.
faq.a4: FootyNet is available in Croatian and English. Switch at any time from the menu.
faq.q5: How do I talk to a club?
faq.a5: Once you have applied, the club can message you and you reply in your FootyNet inbox. You also get an email when a new message arrives.
faq.a6: Yes. Update it on your profile whenever your situation changes, and clubs see the new status straight away.
faq.q7: Can I use FootyNet on my phone?
faq.a7: Yes. FootyNet works in the browser on phones, tablets and computers, so you can reply to a club from the training ground.
